title: Skip the push re-run in every repo when the pushed code is identical to what the PR tested
ruling: Owner 2026-11-13 12:18 CST, page item 729 (pick-joyous-tree-equal-skip), pick a, typed in the coordinator's session: the shared CI form skips the push re-run in every repo when the pushed tree equals the tree the PR tested. It supersedes ruling 176 b's hold for tree-equal merges only; a direct push still runs its suites. q_max and degen (722 a, 723 a) use the shared form.
quote: a) Skip that re-run in every repo when the pushed code is identical to what the PR tested.
